reader_summary.headline: Today, another episode of Behind the Memo.
reader_summary.overview: Today, another episode of Behind the Memo, in which Howard sheds some light on the thought process behind his most recent memo. Here he is discussing the pendulum in international affairs. People often ask what it is that got me started writing the memos.
